observations: La v3 est restée non démarrée après son gate BBO-only échoué; aucune donnée ni résultat de v3 n’est transféré.
L’analyse HYPE l2Book confirme parfois le meilleur bid/ask et leurs quantités pendant un BBO ancien, mais l’âge de la réception l2Book reste soumis à la même limite d’une seconde.
interpretation: La v4 est un test technique paper indépendant du choix causal de la dernière cotation BBO ou du meilleur niveau fast-l2Book disponible. Elle ne teste ni rentabilité ni avantage économique.
claim: À une décision de paper execution, l’utilisation du dernier BBO ou du meilleur niveau fast-l2Book HYPE causalement disponible, reçu depuis au plus une seconde sur la connexion courante et archivé avant la décision, permet de consigner chaque exécution admissible, manquée ou impossible sans inventer une clôture.
signal: Only non-snapshot userFills HYPE events from the subscribed live stream; use signed fill size. REST history and the source entry price are never decision inputs.
entry: Accumulate signed live fill deltas at scale 0.001; target that virtual position, capped at 100 USDC gross exposure. Orders below venue minimum are recorded as missed.
exit: Keep reductions and horizon exits ahead of increases. If a priority exit cannot be simulated by the original 10 second TTL, preserve the virtual residual, append the unresolved-exit diagnostic, and stop this session; never create an accounting close.
execution: Use the latest causally available BBO or fast-l2Book top-of-book snapshot. Keep its source receipt time, archive availability time, source connection id, bid/ask prices and sizes. At every simulated execution require receipt age <=1000ms, availability strictly before decision, and the same currently healthy connection. Heartbeat is connection health only. Log eligible, missed and executed opportunities with source and reason. No live orders.

decision_rules.runtime_health: start only while configured collector and paper engine timer are active and the current HYPE stream connection is healthy
decision_rules.per_execution_quote: require BBO or l2Book receipt age <=1000ms, archived before execution, same healthy connection
decision_rules.quote_unavailable: record missed opportunity and exact reason; preserve any open residual
decision_rules.priority_exit_unresolved: stop session with priority_exit_unresolved_position; preserve residual and final result unknown
decision_rules.loss_limit: stop when predeclared 10 USDC net loss/drawdown limit is reached
decision_rules.duration_end: stop after 30 minutes and produce final automatic report
decision_rules.purpose: technical interpretation only; no profitability decision or economic promotion
